sources.ref: Time Series Momentum, Journal of Financial Economics 2012

supertrend_pullback.mechanism_payer: slow-moving trend persistence and delayed position adjustment; pullback reduces chase cost
supertrend_pullback.observable_event: closed-bar Supertrend/EMA alignment followed by bounded pullback and reclaim
supertrend_pullback.regime: directional trend with acceptable ATR; no-trade on stale, ambiguous, overextended or cost-infeasible state
supertrend_pullback.exit: timeout plus favorable-only ATR/structure trail; no adverse add
supertrend_pullback.turnover: one entry per transition with cooldown
supertrend_pullback.falsification: direction flip/time placebo/delayed entry controls must not reproduce causal advantage

trend_ma_macd.mechanism_payer: trend persistence with momentum re-acceleration timing
trend_ma_macd.observable_event: EMA21/55 aligned trend plus MACD histogram zero-cross/impulse on closed bar
trend_ma_macd.regime: aligned EMA slope; no-trade on weak cross, stale data, chase or insufficient cost budget
trend_ma_macd.turnover: one entry per transition with cooldown
trend_ma_macd.falsification: negative controls plus source-method fidelity fixture

trend_rider.mechanism_payer: persistent directional trend after price remains on one side of adaptive trend/EMA structure
trend_rider.observable_event: Supertrend direction and slope + EMA slope + directionally confirmed continuation bar
trend_rider.regime: persistent trend; no-trade on stale, overextended or ambiguous alignment
trend_rider.exit: timeout plus favorable-only trail; pyramiding disabled in rebuild v1
trend_rider.turnover: one entry per transition with cooldown
trend_rider.falsification: negative controls plus source-method fidelity fixture
